## Codes left out on purpose
- **Parapsoriasis** (M162 and its sub-codes, Myu31) and related conditions (pityriasis rosea M163, pityriasis rubra pilaris M164, pityriasis M165, lymphomatoid papulosis M1628): these are different conditions, despite the similar names.
- **Family history** (12H2, 12H5): these describe a relative, not the patient.
- **H/O: psoriasis** (14F2): a past history code, which doesn't confirm the patient has psoriasis now. Add it if your study wants anyone who has ever had psoriasis.
- **Psoriasis area and severity index score** (38Gg): this is a severity score. It strongly suggests psoriasis but isn't a diagnosis code, so add it only if you want a more sensitive list.

## Codes you may want to review
- **M16 and M16z**: these headings also cover "similar disorders", not just psoriasis.
- **M161G (Acrodermatitis continua), M143 (Impetigo herpetiformis), M1602 (Arthritis mutilans)**: these are usually counted as forms of psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis. Drop them if you want only codes that clearly say "psoriasis".
- **The psoriatic arthritis codes**: drop these if you want skin psoriasis only.
